address: Bosham Lane, Bosham, Chichester, West Sussex,PO18 8HL
bio: Treat yourself to a deluxe Afternoon Tea at the Millstream Hotel, a peaceful hotel and restaurant located in the picturesque village of Bosham, West Sussex.  You will be swept up by the luxurious yet rustic interior, a stunning mix of fine dining and comforting country retreat. Expect starched white tablecloths and fine glassware plus cosy seats and plush velvet upholstery, perfect for tucking into some delicious Afternoon Tea.  A feast of traditional, delicate finger sandwiches awaits you, such as Coronation chicken with coriander and apricots, plus lovingly-baked scones and preserves and a selection of sweets and pastries designed by the in-house pastry chef.  While you may feel like you're at an idyllic retreat miles from anywhere, Bosham Rail Station is just a mile away by car.  Please inform staff of any dietary requirements or allergens on booking.
